title: Implement recovery reconciler for unfinished effects
purpose: Allow agentd to restart and deterministically reconcile effects without asking the model to reinterpret the task.
scope: Scan audit journal for EffectPrepared without CommitSealed or RollbackObserved.
Classify unresolved effects as safe-to-verify, needs-rollback, needs-human-review, or abandoned.
Expose recovery status in TUI and agentd health output.
Require human confirmation before continuing any ambiguous side effect.
acceptance_criteria: agentd restart does not silently discard prepared effects.
Recovery path can resume verification for read-only and simulated write effects.
Ambiguous effects are surfaced to the operator before continuation.
Recovery emits RecoveryStarted and RecoveryCompleted events.
risk_notes: Recovery logic must be deterministic and model-independent.
